verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents both a REST API covering syncs, models, sources, and destinations (with auth via API key) and an official MCP server letting AI agents build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, and analyze performance in plain language, directly matching the story's pipeline-management-by-agent theme. Missing for 10: no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe 404s) and no independent/hands-on evidence of an agent successfully performing full pipeline management end-to-end via these interfaces.
